name: Lu Xiaojian
current_role: Director and General Manager (CEO), Zhejiang Jiecang Linear Motion Technology (603583.SH)
profile: Lu Xiaojian (b. 1970) is a co-founder of Jiecang Linear Motion, a Zhejiang maker of linear actuators for height-adjustable desks, medical beds and smart furniture listed in Shanghai in 2018. He has run the company as general manager since 2010 and holds about 66 million shares.
interesting_fact: He is one of the principal drafters of China's light-industry standard QB/T4288-2012.
deep_cut_fact: He studied applied mathematics at Nanjing University of Science and Technology and spent a decade (1990-2000) as R&D manager at Nanjing Sikai Electronics before joining Jiecang's predecessor, Xinchang Jiecang Medical Equipment, in 2000.
notes: A 2026 Jiecang robotics-actuator brochure lists him as 'Lu Xiaojian (Su Jie), President & CEO, co-founder'. Company is also moving into robot actuators.

name: Song Ziming
profile: Song Ziming was the second-largest shareholder of Kingfa Sci & Tech (600143.SH), the Guangzhou modified-plastics maker. At end-2010 he held about 167.7 million shares (12.01%), behind founder Yuan Zhimin. No current role was found in recent Kingfa disclosures.
interesting_fact: Kingfa's 2010 annual report lists him as its No. 2 shareholder, with 12.01% of the company.
notes: Low public profile. The shareholder link to Kingfa is confirmed, but his current role and any biography were not found. Kingfa's chairman is now Chen Pingxu.

name: Dai Lin
notes: Searches could not link anyone named Dai Lin (代琳) to 'U9 game'. U9 may refer to Shanghai U9 Game / Youjiu Game (游久游戏, 600652, formerly 爱使股份), but no source naming Dai Lin was found. Not identified.

name: Wang Zengduo
current_role: Chairman and Party Secretary, Guanglian Aviation Industry Co. (300900.SZ), Harbin
profile: Wang Zengduo (b. 1963) founded Guanglian Aviation, a Harbin maker of aviation tooling, aerospace parts and drones, and is its controlling shareholder (about 23.6%). A BUAA computer-science graduate, he built a string of Harbin electronics and precision-machinery firms before setting up the aviation composites tooling business in 2011.
interesting_fact: He began his career in 1987 as a computer-centre technician at Harbin Aircraft Manufacturing Corp. He later built his own aviation-tooling supplier.
deep_cut_fact: He graduated from Beijing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics in computer science and engineering. In 1992-96 he chaired the Hafei Group computer company before founding Harbin Guanglian Electronics.
notes: Since 2024 he has also chaired Jingdezhen Hangsheng Aviation Machinery.

name: Zi Zhenjun
current_role: Founder of Venus Medtech (2500.HK); founding partner of Dinova (德诺) Capital
profile: Zi Zhenjun founded Venus Medtech (启明医疗), a Hangzhou maker of transcatheter heart valves and the first company incubated by the Dinova medical group to go public (Hong Kong). He is also a founding partner of Dinova Capital.
interesting_fact: Venus Medtech was the first IPO among the companies incubated by the Dinova medical group.
notes: Sensitive: Venus Medtech shares have been suspended since Nov 23, 2023. Jiemian reported a complaint accusing him of diverting company funds, which he did not answer before publication. Approach with caution.

name: Xiong Xiaobin
current_role: One of the ten joint actual controllers of RemeGen (荣昌生物, 688331.SH / 9995.HK)
profile: Xiong Xiaobin is one of the ten people who together are the actual controllers of RemeGen, the Yantai biotech behind antibody-drug conjugates such as disitamab vedotin. The group includes chairman Wang Weidong and Fang Jianmin. His personal stake is listed at about 0.38%, with more held through partnership vehicles.
interesting_fact: RemeGen is controlled by a 10-person concert group rather than a single founder; Xiong is one of them.
notes: Listed with Xiong Xing (shared_with). No personal biography or current executive title was found. He is not on RemeGen's current director list.

name: Liu Nianxin
current_role: Chairman, President and Board Secretary, Shenzhen Hongtao Group (002325.SZ)
profile: Liu Nianxin (b. 1956) has built Shenzhen Hongtao Group, a public-building interior decoration design and construction firm, since 1989 and remains its controlling shareholder (about 14.6%). He has been chairman since 2007 and added the president and board-secretary roles in September 2024.
interesting_fact: In 2008 the China Building Decoration Association named him one of the entrepreneurs who made outstanding contributions to the industry over 30 years of reform and opening.
deep_cut_fact: He is a senior interior architect, a senior environmental-art designer and a UK Chartered Builder (CIOB).

name: Yu Yongfu
current_role: No current Alibaba management role found. He has done investment work via Alibaba's eWTP fund since March 2024 and was no longer an Alibaba partner per the FY2025 annual report.
profile: Yu Yongfu (b. 1976) was CEO of UCWeb (UC Browser) from 2006 and became an Alibaba senior executive after Alibaba fully acquired UCWeb in 2014. He went on to run Alimama, Alibaba's digital media and entertainment unit, Amap (Gaode) and Ele.me. In March 2024 he stepped down from those roles to do investment work through the eWTP fund.
interesting_fact: Inside Alibaba, his record of taking over and merging businesses earned him the saying 'for integration, find Yongfu' (要整合，找永福).
deep_cut_fact: In 2001 he joined Legend Capital as a founding employee and rose to vice president before joining UCWeb as CEO in 2006, when it had 6 employees and a single product.
notes: No personal published contact found. He no longer has an Alibaba management role, so Alibaba press channels may not apply. Source for leaving the partnership: https://www.jiemian.com/article/13010108.html

name: TT Jagannathan
profile: Former chairman (later chairman emeritus) of the TTK Group / TTK Prestige. He died in October 2025.
interesting_fact: He invented the gasket release system that stops pressure cookers from bursting and chose not to patent it.
notes: Deceased: TTK Prestige told the stock exchanges of his death in Oct 2025 (exchange4media: https://www.exchange4media.com/media-others-news/tt-jagannathan-chairman-emeritus-of-ttk-group-no-more-148285.html; tribute in Madras Musings, Oct 16-31, 2025 issue).

name: Qu Chenghong
current_role: Co-actual controller (about 11.3% holder), Guangzhou Sanfu New Materials Technology (688359.SH)
profile: Qu Chenghong and chairman Shangguan Wenlong are the joint actual controllers of Guangzhou Sanfu New Materials (三孚新科), a STAR-listed maker of surface-treatment chemicals and electroplating equipment. The direct stake is about 11.29%.
notes: Listed with Shangguan Wenlong (shared_with). No personal biography found. Not on the company's listed executive roster.

name: Jia Tongchun
current_role: Major individual shareholder of Beijing New Building Materials (BNBM, 000786.SZ); no current executive role found
profile: Jia Tongchun received 121.6 million new BNBM shares in October 2016, when BNBM issued shares to buy out the minority holders of its gypsum-board subsidiary Taishan Gypsum. He was the largest individual recipient in the deal, and it made him one of BNBM's main individual shareholders.
interesting_fact: In the 2016 CSRC-approved deal, BNBM issued 121,616,516 shares to Jia Tongchun, second only to Tai'an Guotai Minan Investment Group.
notes: Searches turned up no personal biography. That he led Taishan Gypsum is not confirmed by any source read here, so check before using it.

name: Liu Guang
current_role: Former chairman and actual controller of NetPosa Technologies (东方网力, 300367.SZ); no current role found
profile: Liu Guang was the actual controller and chairman of NetPosa, a Beijing video-surveillance and video-analytics software company. He ceased to be actual controller in September 2019, left the chairmanship in January 2020 and resigned as director in April 2020. NetPosa is now controlled by the Sichuan provincial SASAC.
notes: A CSRC penalty decision (https://www.csrc.gov.cn/beijing/c105546/c7468816/content.shtml) names him over NetPosa disclosure violations from 2017-2020. His fortune has likely fallen sharply. Probably not a fit for outreach.

name: Zhao Zeming
current_role: Co-founder, director and deputy general manager; one of three joint actual controllers (17.5%) of Hiecise Precision Equipment (华辰装备, 300809.SZ)
profile: Zhao Zeming co-founded Hiecise Precision Equipment (Huachen) in Kunshan, which makes high-precision roll grinders and other grinding machines and is listed on ChiNext. He shares control with Liu Xiangxiong and chairman Cao Yuzhong, holding about 17.5%.
interesting_fact: Besides roll grinders, Hiecise's product line includes precision thread grinders, precision CNC linear-guide grinders and ultra-precision curved-surface grinders.
notes: His deputy GM and director titles come from MarketScreener/CB Insights search snippets, not from a page I read in full.

name: Dou Baode
current_role: Chairman and controlling shareholder (about 47.4%), Shandong Bailong Chuangyuan Bio-Tech (百龙创园, 605016.SH)
profile: Dou Baode (b. 1964) founded Bailong Chuangyuan in Yucheng, Shandong, a maker of functional sugars and dietary fibres such as allulose, resistant dextrin, polydextrose and oligosaccharides. He has chaired the Shanghai-listed company since 2016 and is a member of the 13th Shandong Provincial CPPCC.
interesting_fact: Bailong produces allulose, a rare low-calorie sugar, alongside prebiotic fibres used across the food and beverage industry.
deep_cut_fact: He has a high-school education and started out running the Lunzhen township supply-and-marketing cooperative in Yucheng (1983-95), then ran a local trading company and an agricultural-supplies firm before founding Bailong.
notes: Listed with Dou Guangming (shared_with). Filings list Dou Guangpeng (窦光朋) as co-controller.
